description: NASA’s Curiosity rover has resumed science operations after solar conjunction, returning to a previous drill site for a rare organic chemistry experiment. Using its final supply of TMAH, Curiosity will analyse Martian rock samples for signs of organic molecules while also monitoring dust and atmospheric conditions inside Gale Crater.
title: Curiosity Rover Reconnects After Solar Conjunction, Begins Critical Organic Search on Mars

description: A mysterious neutrino detected in 2023 may be debris from an exploding primordial black hole. Scientists say the ultra-energetic particle defies known cosmic sources and could represent Hawking radiation, offering rare insight into early-universe physics and the possible nature of dark matter while challenging theories of black holes and cosmology.
title: Impossible Neutrino Detected on Earth May Come From an Exploding Primordial Black Hole

description: Itel A100 will launch in India soon. The brand shared an official teaser for the upcoming A-series smartphone showcasing its design, colour variants, and key features. The handset will be available in three colour options. The Itel A100 is expected to arrive as the successor to the Itel A90.
title: Itel A100 Confirmed to Launch in India Soon; Colourways, Battery Capacity and Durability Teased

description: HBO is set to adapt Baldur's Gate 3 into a drama TV series with The Last of Us co-creator Craig Mazin at the helm. Mazin will create, write, executive produce, and showrun the new adaptation, according to a report published Thursday. Baldur's Gate 3 developer Larian Studios is not involved with the TV adaptation of the acclaimed game.
title: After The Last of Us, HBO Is Adapting Baldur's Gate 3 for TV With Craig Mazin as Creator

description: Apple has started hiring Store Managers, Senior Managers, and Store Leaders in Hyderabad, according to three new job listings on the iPhone maker's website in India. This signals that the Cupertino-based tech giant could be planning to open its sixth store in the country, after Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Pune, and Noida. This comes soon after Apple's Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Tim Cook stated during the Q1 earnings call that the tech giant will open its second branded store in Mumbai "soon".
title: Apple Eyes Retail Expansion in India, New Job Listings Hint at Apple Store in Hyderabad

description: Agentic coding models have come a long way, evolving from simple code completers into full-fledged collaborators that manage entire workflows. With the enterprise space presenting a major revenue opportunity, all the big artificial intelligence (AI) players are trying to capture this market. But with overlapping strengths, the real question boils down to value. Which one delivers more bang for the buck in terms of performance, safety, and everyday utility?
title: Claude Opus 4.6 vs GPT-5.3-Codex: Which Agentic Coding Model Offers the Best Value

description: Poco X8 Pro series, which will reportedly include the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max, is expected to launch soon. While the Chinese smartphone maker has yet confirm the unveiling, a landing page on the company website in Belgium briefly went live, revealing the pricing, colourways, and storage configurations of the smartphones. The phones are shown to go on sale in Europe in black, white, and green colourways. While the Poco X8 Pro Max might be offered in two RAM and storage options, the Poco X8 Pro could be available in three variants.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Price, Colourways Inadvertently Listed on Xiaomi Website in Europe: Expected Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G will launch in India on February 9. The phone is expected to be priced between Rs. 10,000 and Rs. 15,000, and will be sold via Flipkart and Samsung’s online store. It features a vegan leather design with IP54 rating, a 120Hz display with up to 800 nits brightness, and a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. Samsung confirms a 50-megapixel dual rear camera setup and a 6,000mAh battery with 25W charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Specifications, Features and More

description: WhatsApp may soon let users share Status updates with a Close Friends list, offering more privacy and control over who can view certain posts. WABetaInfo spotted the feature in an Android beta build, though it remains under development with no release timeline confirmed. The option could work alongside custom contact lists, allowing users to manage Close Friends through Status settings or the Status screen.
title: WhatsApp Will Soon Let You Add a 'Close Friends' Status, Just Like Instagram: Report

description: Google announced the February 2026 Discover core update on Thursday, a broad change to systems that surface content in Discover. It emphasises locally relevant articles from websites in users' countries, boosts original, expert-driven and timely pieces, and dials back sensational or clickbait-style content. The update started for English users in the US and will expand globally over the months.
title: Google's February 2026 Discover Core Update to Focus on Local Content, Reduce Clickbait

description: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5.3-Codex, its most advanced agentic coding model yet. It merges frontier coding strengths from GPT-5.2-Codex with improved reasoning and professional knowledge from GPT-5.2, all in one system that runs 25 percent faster. The model handles extended workflows involving research, tool use and complex execution while allowing users to interact and steer it mid-task like a colleague.
title: GPT-5.3-Codex Released as OpenAI’s First AI Model to Assist in Its Own Development

description: Lava Yuva Star 3 has surfaced in a leaked image, offering an early look at its design ahead of an expected India launch. The phone appears in matte black with a rounded rectangular camera island housing dual circular rings and an LED flash. The module suggests a 13-megapixel AI camera setup. The handset may arrive in more colour options, though launch details remain unclear. It will succeed the Lava Yuva Star 2, launched in May 2025.
title: Lava Yuva Star 3 Will Reportedly Launch in India Soon With Redesigned Camera Module

description: The Oppo Find N6 is rumoured to be launched soon as the successor to the Find N5. While the company has yet to confirm the purported book-style foldable handset, its launch timeline has been teased by a company official. It will debut in the region after the Chinese New Year, aligning with the previously rumoured launch window. The Oppo Find N6 is expected to be the first foldable powered by Qualcomm's flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Oppo Find N6 China Launch Timeline, Durability Improvements Teased: Expected Features, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G has been spotted on the Bluetooth SIG certification website with the SM-A576B/DS model number. The listing suggests that the handset could be launched by the South Korean smartphone maker in select global markets soon. This comes soon after the Galaxy A57 5G was listed on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database with the same model number. The phone is expected to be unveiled later this month with Samsung’s Exynos 1680 chipset. Its supposed predecessor, the Galaxy A56 5G, was launched in India in March 2025.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G Could Launch Soon as Handset Surfaces on Bluetooth SIG Database

description: Created by Paul Coates, Unfamiliar is a German Spy Thriller Series that has finally made its way to the digital screens. Streaming now, only on Netflix.
title: Unfamiliar Now Streaming on Netflix: Everything You Need to Know About Plot, Cast, and More

description: Xiaomi 17T Pro is expected to be launched later this month as a successor to the  Xiaomi 15T Pro. As we wait for the formal launch date announcement, details about the handset have leaked on Weibo. The Xiaomi 17T Pro is tipped to run onthe  MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chipset. It is said to offer IP69 rated build for dust and water resistance. If the leak turns out to be true, Xiaomi 17T Pro would bring a major upgrade in battery capacity and charging speed compared to the Xiaomi 15T Pro.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro Leak Reveals Chipset, Battery, Durability and Other Key Specifications

description: Directed by Arun Varma, Baby Girl is a Malayalam film that is now landing on the digital screens on Feb 12th, 2026. It stars Nivin Pauly in the lead role.
title: Baby Girl OTT Release Date Revealed: When and Where to Watch Nivin Pauly’s Film Online?

description: Brave Ark 2-in-1 has been launched in India. Currently available for purchase in the country via Amazon, the Android PC is offered in Galactic Blue colour way and a single 12GB+256GB RAM and storage configuration. The device is equipped with a 12.95-inch 2.8K (‎2,880x1,840 pixels) IPS touchscreen, delivering up to 144Hz of refresh rate, up to 700 nits of peak brightness, 264ppi pixel density, and 96 percent colour gamut coverage. It is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset, which is paired with an Adreno 732 GPU.
title: Brave Ark 2-in-1 Android PC Launched in India With 14,550mAh Battery, 12.95-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Honor X80 may expand Honor’s 10,000mAh battery strategy into the budget segment, according to a tipster. The phone is expected to pack a 10,000mAh+ battery, a 6.81-inch flat LTPS 1.5K display, and a next-generation Snapdragon 6-series chipset, possibly the SM6850. It may be priced under CNY 1,000 (roughly Rs. 13,000). The tipster also claims Honor’s recent 10,000mAh models have performed well, with bigger batteries possible for the Magic series.
title: Honor X80 Tipped to Launch With Large Battery, Snapdragon Chip and Low Price Tag

description: HBO and A24’s Neighbors is a bold new reality docuseries exploring real, heated conflicts between neighbors across America. Inspired by viral videos of neighborhood fights, the series captures authentic disputes over pets, property boundaries, lifestyle clashes, and more. The first installment launches February 13, 2026 on JioHotstar, featuring six episodes of unfiltered, on-the-ground footage.
title: Neighbors OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Ubisoft has reportedly cancelled a multiplayer co-op Assassin's Creed game in the works at its Annecy studio. The game was reportedly set in portions of the open world seen in Assassin's Creed Shadows and supported up to four-player co-op multiplayer. Ubisoft cancelled six games last month as a part of a company-wide reset.
title: Ubisoft Reportedly Cancels Co-Op Multiplayer Assassin's Creed Game

description: Alan Ritchson headlines War Machine, an action-packed sci-fi thriller streaming on Netflix from March 6, 2026. Directed by Patrick Hughes, the film follows elite Army Rangers facing an unimaginable enemy during a routine exercise. With explosive action, suspense, and a powerful cast, War Machine aims to deliver a gripping global streaming experience.
title: War Machine OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Anthropic has unveiled Claude Opus 4.6, an upgraded flagship model that enhances performance in coding, agentic tasks and real-world applications. It features a one-million token context window in beta, adaptive thinking controls and context compaction for sustained efficiency. The model outperforms predecessors on multiple benchmarks and includes robust safeguards against misuse.
title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Opus 4.6 AI Model With Improved Agentic Performance

description: Apple is reportedly scaling back plans to launch its AI-powered virtual health coach feature, as it winds down Project Mulberry. This comes as the company is facing increasing competition from other health-tech companies, including OpenAI with its ChatGPT Health, Oura, and Whoop. The division recently underwent a management change, too. Additonally, Tim Cook, the Chief Executive Officer of Apple, has hinted that the company could launch new AI-based product categories and services.
title: Apple Said to Wind Down Virtual AI Health Coach Project Amidst Increasing Competition

description: The MediaTek Dimensity 9500s processor for flagship mobile devices was launched in the global markets in January, and the chipmaker has now confirmed that it will be available in India soon. During an event in New Delhi on Friday, MediaTek announced that several upcoming smartphones in the country will be powered by the aforementioned chipset, including the Oppo Find X9s, which is targeting a Q2 2026 launch. It is also reported to power one of the models in the purported Poco X8 series.
title: Oppo Find X9s, Poco X8 Series to Be First Smartphones to Launch in India With MediaTek Dimensity 9500s Chip

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra could launch later this month. As the rumoured launch date is drawing closer, a new render of the phone has emerged, offering a clearer and more detailed look at the flagship. The leak shows the phone with a redesigned rear camera island housing four sensors. It has a hole-punch display design with more rounded corners. It is expected to be launched on February 25 alongside the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ models.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 3D Concept Render Offers a 360-Degree Look at Its Design

description: Google has reportedly teased that its AirDrop interoperability could soon be expanded to support a wider range of Android smartphones. The Mountain View-based tech giant first announced cross-platform sharing between Android and iOS devices in November 2025 for the Pixel 10, enabling Android users to share files securely and wirelessly with iPhone owners, and vice versa, using both Quick Share and AirDrop.
title: Google's AirDrop-Quick Share Interoperability Support Is Coming to More Android Smartphones

description: A new leak hints that Apple is considering a larger battery in the iPhone 18 Pro Max. The Chinese version of the iPhone 18 Pro Max is tipped to feature a 5,000mAh battery. The battery capacity of the international variant of the phone could range between 5,100mAh and 5,200mAh. It is expected to come with a  2nm A20 Pro chip and a 6.86-inch LTPO display. The existing iPhone 17 Pro Max is believed to have a 5,088mAh battery.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Leak Reveals Battery Capacity; Chinese Variant Said to Pack Smaller Battery

description: OpenAI has rolled out Frontier, a new enterprise platform designed to help companies build, deploy and manage AI agents that handle genuine business tasks. The system gives agents shared business context, onboarding processes, feedback-driven learning and strict permission controls, allowing them to operate across fragmented tools without requiring companies to replace existing infrastructure. Several large organisations have already started using or piloting it.
title: OpenAI Frontier Introduced as an Enterprise Platform to Align AI Agents With Real Work

description: Oppo Find X9s series phones and the Find X9 Ultra have reportedly received SRRC and UFCS certifications in China, hinting at an imminent launch. The Oppo PMA110 model, believed to be the Find X9 Ultra, has appeared in the SRRC database, confirming support for cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth connectivity. It has also surfaced in UFCS listings alongside PMA120, which may offer satellite features. Oppo’s PME110 and PHM110 models are tipped as Find X9s variants.
title: Oppo Find X9s, Find X9 Ultra Reportedly Receive SRRC, UFCS Approvals Hinting at Imminent Launch

description: Sony and Guerrilla Games have announced Horizon Hunters Gathering, a live service co-op action game set in the world of Horizon Zero Dawn and Horizon Forbidden West. The game will support three-player co-op and let players team and take down deadly Horizon machines. The game will launch on PC and PS5.
title: Sony Announces Horizon Hunters Gathering, a Live Service Co-Op Action Game for PS5 and PC

description: Google Pixel 10a will be launched later this month. Just days before the official reveal, alleged renders of the phone leaked online. The renders show the phone in black, red, off-white, and lavender colour options, and they could be marketed as Obsidian, Berry, Fog, and Lavender, respectively. Google already teased the phone in a Lavender shade. It is expected to come with a 6.3-inch AMOLED display and the Tensor G4 chipset.
title: Google Pixel 10a Spotted in Leaked Renders Ahead of February 18 Launch in Four Colour Options

description: Sony has confirmed that its next-generation WF-1000XM6 flagship earbuds will be unveiled on February 12. Teasers align with an earlier leak, which suggested a more compact design, slimmer charging case, and colour options including black, silver, and possibly Sandpink. Leaks hint at upgrades such as DSEE Ultimate audio upscaling powered by a MediaTek MT2855 chip, improved ANC, battery life, and processing performance, along with an IPX4 rating.
title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Launch Date Announced: Expected Price, Colourways and Specifications

description: Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 17 Ultra are reportedly scheduled to be launched by the smartphone maker in select global markets ahead of the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026, which starts on March 2 in Barcelona. While the company has yet to reveal the launch date, a Xiaomi executive recently confirmed that the Xiaomi 17 Ultra will be unveiled globally soon. Ahead of the debut, the renders of the Xiaomi 17 Ultra and standard model have been leaked. Separately, a tipster has shared the key specifications of the Xiaomi 17’s global variant.
title: Xiaomi 17 Series Global Variants Spotted in New Colourway; Tipster Leaks Key Specifications

description: The iPhone 17e is widely rumoured to launch in 2026 as Apple’s next-generation affordable iPhone. While the company has yet to confirm the successor to the iPhone 16e, its launch date has now been leaked. According to a report, the purported handset could see the light of day as soon as February. The iPhone 17e is expected to have a similar overall design to its predecessor, with rumours that Dynamic Island could replace the notch dismissed.
title: iPhone 17e to Reportedly Launch in February; May Feature C1X Chip and MagSafe Charging

description: SpaceX’s Starlink looks to expand beyond broadband connectivity and introduce new services such as direct-to-phone communication. According to a report, the satellite internet service’s mobile device could connect to the constellation of Starlink satellites and rival smartphones. Starlink’s rising subscriber base and expanding range of use cases are reportedly helping SpaceX strengthen its commercial business and fuel the long-term vision.
title: SpaceX’s Starlink Reportedly Eyes Expansion Into Mobile Device Market and Direct-to-Device Connectivity

description: Qualcomm announced the company’s financial performance in the first fiscal quarter of the year on Wednesday. While the company posted robust growth numbers and even surpassed market expectations, it set the lowered revenue expectations for the next quarter. During the Q1 2026 earnings call with investors and analysts, Akash Palkhiwala, Chief Financial Officer at Qualcomm, said several smartphone brands were looking to reduce the production of units.
title: Qualcomm Reveals Smartphone Brands Are Planning to Reduce Shipments Amid Global Memory Shortage
